Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the authority of the Columbia river gorge commission.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authority of the Columbia river gorgecommission; and adding a new section to chapter 43.97 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.97 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The commission may not issue a land use decision that prohibitsreasonable development of a property or parcel unless the commissioncompensates the owner for the loss in value due to the inability toreasonably develop the property or parcel. The loss in value shall bedetermined by the assessor of the county in which the property orparcel is located. (2) The commission shall not serve as an adjudicatory body and maynot hear any appeals of land use or building permit decisions. Allsuch appeals within the commission's jurisdiction shall be heard by thesuperior court of competent jurisdiction.
